title: Your production partner
caption: One workspace for your stream, your audience, and your next cue.
narration: Meet Cue, your AI livestream producer. Plan your show, connect your studio, and bring your audience into the action, all from one desktop workspace.

title: Start with an idea
caption: Describe your stream. Choose a director style. Create your plan.
narration: Start with a simple brief. We're planning a city walk where chat picks the next challenge. Choose a director style, then create your stream plan.

title: Make the show your own
caption: Edit the title, category, tags, and timed running order.
narration: Cue turns the brief into an editable running order. Refine your title, category, tags, and timed segments before the show begins.

title: Connect your studio
caption: Twitch + OBS + a staged overlay. This walkthrough uses Demo Mode.
narration: Connect Twitch and OBS, then stage the Cue overlay in your scene. This walkthrough uses Demo Mode to demonstrate the workflow without starting a public broadcast.

title: Go live with intention
caption: Check readiness. Review the confirmation. Start the session.
narration: Run the readiness check, review the confirmation, and start the session. Cue keeps broadcast controls explicit, so you decide when the show goes live.

title: Let chat shape the show
caption: Repeated chat topics become contextual overlay cues, with evidence.
narration: Now chat asks for a challenge. Cue spots the repeated topic and turns it into an audience prompt. The director feed shows the supporting messages, the decision, and the result.

title: Stay in the director's chair
caption: Pause automation whenever you need to. Resume on your terms.
narration: You stay in control. Pause the director at any time to stop automatic cues, then resume when you're ready to bring chat back into the show.

title: Wrap up. Take the recap with you.
caption: Export your session recap as Markdown or JSON.
narration: When you're done, end the session and export a recap of your production actions and highlight suggestions. Cue. Your stream, right on cue.
